verdict.rationale: Polar exposes a full API/SDK and an official remote MCP server explicitly described as giving agents 'secure access to your Polar organization' to 'look up data and take actions across your products, customers, subscriptions, orders, benefits' (polar-supp-mcp, polar-probe-4/5), plus a versioned OpenAPI spec and Checkout Session API for API-driven payment links (polar-docs-8, polar-supp-checkout-links, polar-probe-6). This supports an agent programmatically creating a product, price, and checkout link via API/MCP in one session, but no evidence pack item shows a concrete end-to-end example or transcript of an agent doing all three steps in a single session. Missing for 10: an explicit documented/demoed workflow showing product+price+payment-link creation chained in one agent session, and independent corroboration of MCP write-actions succeeding in practice.
